source: DRAFT written by Claude on 2026-11-03 for review; continues ep1. Sources to verify by the writer: Brahma's manasa-putra Saptarishi and Svayambhuva Manu & Shatarupa (Vishnu Purana 1.7, Bhagavata Purana 3.12, Manusmriti 1); 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam' (Maha Upanishad 6.71). 'Manu -> Manav' is the traditional folk etymology.

style.look: stylized 3D animated family film, soft global illumination, gentle depth of field, expressive faces, warm and reverent
style.negative: photorealistic, text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed face, flicker

tara.description: 8-year-old Indian girl, two braids with red ribbons, big expressive brown eyes, yellow cotton kurta

dadi.description: 70-year-old Indian grandmother, silver hair in a bun, round gold-rim glasses, cream cotton saree with maroon border, kind wrinkles, warm smile

brahma.description: Lord Brahma, four bearded faces, four arms holding Vedas, lotus, kamandalu and rosary, saffron-gold garments, seated on pink lotus, serene

manu.description: Manu, the first man: young adult Indian man, calm kind face, short dark beard, hair tied in a top knot, simple saffron dhoti and shawl, rudraksha beads, barefoot

shatarupa.description: Shatarupa, the first woman: young adult Indian woman, gentle smile, long braided hair with white flowers, simple cream sari with gold border, barefoot

living_room_night.description: the same cozy living room, now at night: deep blue window with stars, warm lamp light, brass diya lit, a small tulsi plant in a pot on the windowsill

music.prompt: soft devotional ambient, tanpura drone, bansuri flute, gentle, 70 bpm

lines.speaker: tara
lines.caption: Daadi, paanch tattva toh ban gaye... par ped, jaanvar aur insaan kahaan se aaye?
lines.tts: दादी, पाँच तत्व तो बन गए... पर पेड़, जानवर और इंसान कहाँ से आए?

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Bahut achha sawaal! Brahma ji ne socha — is sundar duniya mein ab jeevan chahiye.
lines.tts: बहुत अच्छा सवाल! ब्रह्मा जी ने सोचा — इस सुंदर दुनिया में अब जीवन चाहिए।

shots.keyframe_prompt: wide shot, Dadi and Tara sitting together on the sofa at night, Tara looking at the tulsi plant on the windowsill, diya glowing, stars in the window
shots.motion_prompt: gentle settle, diya flame flickers, Tara turns her head from the window to Dadi, static camera

shots.keyframe_prompt: medium close-up of Tara seated on the right of the sofa, curious thoughtful eyes, looking toward screen-left at Dadi
shots.motion_prompt: Tara asks thoughtfully, slight head tilt

shots.keyframe_prompt: medium close-up of Dadi seated on the left of the sofa, pleased smile, looking toward screen-right at Tara
shots.motion_prompt: Dadi smiles and begins the story, gentle hand gesture

shots.keyframe_prompt: close-up of the brass diya flame on the table
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in into the diya flame until warm golden light fills the frame

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Brahma ji ne aankhen band karke dhyaan kiya. Unke mann se saat mahaan rishi prakat hue — Saptarishi — jo gyaan ke rakshak bane.
lines.tts: ब्रह्मा जी ने आँखें बंद करके ध्यान किया। उनके मन से सात महान ऋषि प्रकट हुए — सप्तर्षि — जो ज्ञान के रक्षक बने।

shots.keyframe_prompt: Brahma seated on a pink lotus in golden cosmic light, eyes closed in meditation, serene
shots.motion_prompt: Brahma breathes calmly in meditation, a soft glow gathers at his forehead
shots.vo: ब्रह्मा जी ने आँखें बंद करके ध्यान किया।
shots.vo_caption: Brahma ji ne aankhen band karke dhyaan kiya.

shots.last_frame_prompt: seven small radiant points of white-gold light floating above meditating Brahma against the deep indigo sky
shots.motion_prompt: seven points of light rise gently one after another from Brahma's forehead and float upward
shots.vo: उनके मन से सात महान ऋषि प्रकट हुए —
shots.vo_caption: Unke mann se saat mahaan rishi prakat hue -

shots.keyframe_prompt: seven bright stars forming the Saptarishi (Big Dipper) constellation in a deep indigo night sky, faint glowing lines joining them
shots.motion_prompt: the stars twinkle softly, faint constellation lines glow and fade
shots.vo: सप्तर्षि — जो ज्ञान के रक्षक बने।
shots.vo_caption: Saptarishi - jo gyaan ke rakshak bane.

clips.title: Dharti Par Jeevan (Life Fills the Earth)

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Phir dharti par hariyaali chhaa gayi — ped-paudhe uge, nadiyaan baheen, aur paani, zameen aur aasmaan mein tarah-tarah ke jeev aaye: machhliyaan, panchhi aur jaanvar!
lines.tts: फिर धरती पर हरियाली छा गई — पेड़-पौधे उगे, नदियाँ बहीं, और पानी, ज़मीन और आसमान में तरह-तरह के जीव आए: मछलियाँ, पंछी और जानवर!

shots.first_frame_prompt: close view of a young barren brown-grey Earth landscape at dawn, rocky plains and hills, no plants
shots.last_frame_prompt: the same landscape now lush and green with trees, grass and a winding blue river at dawn
shots.motion_prompt: green life spreads across the land, trees sprout and grow, a river begins to flow
shots.vo: फिर धरती पर हरियाली छा गई — पेड़-पौधे उगे, नदियाँ बहीं,
shots.vo_caption: Phir dharti par hariyaali chhaa gayi - ped-paudhe uge, nadiyaan baheen,

shots.keyframe_prompt: clear river with colourful fish swimming under the water surface, sunlight rays
shots.motion_prompt: fish swim gracefully, water ripples, light rays shimmer
shots.vo: और पानी, ज़मीन और आसमान में तरह-तरह के जीव आए: मछलियाँ,
shots.vo_caption: aur paani, zameen aur aasmaan mein tarah-tarah ke jeev aaye: machhliyaan,

shots.keyframe_prompt: flock of colourful birds, parrots and peacock, flying over green treetops at sunrise
shots.motion_prompt: birds fly across the sky over the trees, peacock spreads its feathers

shots.keyframe_prompt: gentle forest clearing by the river with a baby elephant, deer, rabbits and a cow, friendly and calm
shots.motion_prompt: each animal moves gently on its own: the cow grazes, the deer lowers its head to nibble grass, the rabbits hop a little, the baby elephant slowly swings its own trunk; slow push-in

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Aur phir Brahma ji ne pehle insaanon ko banaaya — Manu aur Shatarupa. Manu se hi hum sab 'maanav' kehlaaye.
lines.tts: और फिर ब्रह्मा जी ने पहले इंसानों को बनाया — मनु और शतरूपा। मनु से ही हम सब 'मानव' कहलाए।

shots.keyframe_prompt: Brahma on his lotus holding out both hands, two soft human-shaped forms of golden light forming before him
shots.motion_prompt: the two golden forms brighten and take human shape
shots.vo: और फिर ब्रह्मा जी ने पहले इंसानों को बनाया —
shots.vo_caption: Aur phir Brahma ji ne pehle insaanon ko banaaya -

shots.keyframe_prompt: Manu and Shatarupa standing side by side on a green riverbank at sunrise, Manu on the left, Shatarupa on the right, looking at the rising sun with wonder
shots.motion_prompt: they look at each other and smile, then look at the sunrise, gentle breeze in the grass

shots.keyframe_prompt: closer two-shot of Manu and Shatarupa smiling
shots.vo: मनु से ही हम सब 'मानव' कहलाए।
shots.vo_caption: Manu se hi hum sab 'maanav' kehlaaye.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.caption: Toh iska matlab... ped, panchhi, jaanvar aur hum — sab ek hi parivaar hain?
lines.tts: तो इसका मतलब... पेड़, पंछी, जानवर और हम — सब एक ही परिवार हैं?

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Haan beta! Isiliye hamare shaastra kehte hain — Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam — poori dharti ek parivaar hai.
lines.tts: हाँ बेटा! इसीलिए हमारे शास्त्र कहते हैं — वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम् — पूरी धरती एक परिवार है।

notes_vo: Narrated clips: each non-TALK shot names its phrase of the line ('vo') and its caption ('vo_caption'); the clip plays that phrase on that shot.
